0.content: Rhinedottir, called "Gold", is the Khaenri'ahn alchemist who created Albedo through the Art of Khemia. She raised him as her apprentice in domains, a cold and strict teacher whom he still regards as his only kin. "She was not his birth mother, but there is no doubt that his life stems from her." When they found the Heart of Naberius, she vanished, leaving a note, a letter of recommendation to Alice, a manuscript of the Opus Magnum and his final assignment: "show me the truth and the meaning of this world."

1.content: Alice, the famed travel writer and Rhinedottir's old friend, received Albedo's letter of recommendation. Since he needed a real laboratory, she "threw him into the Knights of Favonius" and told him: "We'll be a family from now on, treat her like a real younger sister!" "Her" was Alice's daughter Klee. Albedo views Klee as his sister and spends most of his spare energy fixing her explosive disasters. He consoles himself that Klee's destructiveness is nothing next to Alice's. Klee adores him; she knows his "Experiment in Progress" sign means "come back later, Klee."

2.content: The original Durin was Rhinedottir's dragon, killed by Dvalin over Dragonspine five hundred years ago; Albedo was stationed there partly to watch its remains. Its lingering will grew jealous on learning it was no longer Rhinedottir's only child. In 5.6 Albedo killed that will and transmuted Mini Durin, a gentle dragon from the storybook world of Simulanka who chose to become human, into a synthetic human who inherited it. Albedo now calls him "my brother" and his "closest kin".

3.comment: Albedo: Subject Two and the Shadows Amidst Snowstorms
3.content: During the 2.3 Shadows Amidst Snowstorms event (limited), an Albedo with no mark on its neck appeared on Dragonspine. A mutated whopperflower made with Durin's blood took Albedo's shape, and Albedo stabbed it from behind to reveal it. Privately, he told the Traveler that he is synthetic and explained his mark. Then he saw the true impostor watching from a cliff and went to meet him. Subject Two was Rhinedottir's failed earlier experiment, abandoned in Durin's stomach and revived by the dragon's power. He had studied Albedo's notes and wanted to replace him and "experience the joy of being brought into the world".

4.content: In his Story Quest (1.2) on Dragonspine, Albedo deduced from their elemental powers, used without a Vision, that they come from another world. He ran a series of harmless experiments on them, concluded they were much like an ordinary person, and bloomed a seed from beyond Teyvat. Afterwards, looking at strange sediment in a vial, he wondered aloud whether the Traveler could stop him if he ever lost control and threatened what he holds dear. He trusts them with secrets precisely because "you and I are both 'different'."
